<p class="page-intro">From observed patterns to ecological processes: quantitative tools for biodiversity research and wildlife conservation.</p>

## Research focus

I combine Bayesian models, spatial data and ecological knowledge to study mammal abundance, distribution and habitat use. My work connects camera traps, distance sampling and hunting records, with applications in monitoring design and wildlife management.

## Applied collaborations

### LIFE Iberconejo

My contribution as an external consultant has focused on rabbit population monitoring and abundance modelling, combining distance sampling and abundance indices. [Project website](https://www.iberconejo.eu/en/home/).

## Research software

### rWind

An R package for working with wind and sea-current data and measuring connectivity between locations. Creator and maintainer. [Read the paper](https://doi.org/10.1111/ecog.03730).

### abmR

An R package for spatially explicit, agent-based simulations of animal movement. Co-author. [Read the paper](https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210X.14014).
